For this assignment, I used weather data in NY from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Association (NOAA) of the National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI). This data includes the GHCN (Global Historical Climatology Network)-Daily database of summary statistics from weather stations around the world. For the purposes of this assignment, I used the NY state-level data provided. This dataset has five core variables for all New York state weather stations from January 1, 1981 through December 31, 2010.

```{r setup, include = F}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)

set.seed(42)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE)

nynoaa = read_csv("data/nynoaadat.csv")

# As this is a huge dataset and plotly cannot handle this many points, I will be taking a random sample of 10,000 of the rows in this dataset with no NA values

nynoaa = nynoaa |> 
  mutate(
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax),
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin),
    snow = as.numeric(snow),
    snwd = as.numeric(snwd),
    prcp = as.numeric(prcp)
  ) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  slice_sample(n = 10000)

#According to the codebook, precipitation is reported in tenths of mm, so we need to divide by 10; tmax and tmin are also in tenths of degrees C

nynoaa = 
  nynoaa |> 
  mutate(
    prcp = prcp/10,
    tmax = tmax/10,
    tmin = tmin/10
  )
```

Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Maximum temperature over time
```{r}
nynoaa |> 
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE),
    text_label = str_c("Date: ", date, "\nMaximum Temperature: ", tmax, " °C")) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~date, y = ~tmax, color = ~month, colors = "viridis", type = "scatter", text = ~text_label, mode = "markers", alpha = 0.5)
```


Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Snowfall on snowy days, by year
```{r}
nynoaa |> 
  filter(snow > 0) |> 
  mutate(year = factor(lubridate::year(date)),
         text_label = str_c("Year: ", year, "\nSnowfall: ", snow, "mm")) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~year, y = ~snow, color = ~year, type = "violin", text = ~text_label, colors = "viridis")
```

### Average maximum temperature by month and year
```{r}
nynoaa |> 
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE),
    temp_range = tmax - tmin) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~month, y = ~temp_range, color = ~month, type = "box", colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Daily temperature range, tmax − tmin (°C)"))
```
